title: Algebraization of a formal comparison over a complete affine base
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring complete for an ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$, and $J$ the ideal sheaf of $I$. Let $p:Z\to S$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], fix an adjunction $a:p^*\dashv p_*$ [def-pc-module-pullback], let $G$ be a coherent formal $J$-system, $F$ coherent on $Z$, and assume $D=p_*F$ coherent [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, pqf-def-coherent]. Let $\beta:p^*G\simeq F^\wedge$, $\kappa:D^\wedge\to p_*(F^\wedge)$ and $\alpha:G\to D^\wedge$ satisfy $\pi^J_n\kappa_n=p_*(\pi^{J\mathcal O_Z}_n)$ and $\alpha_n\kappa_n=\eta^a_{G_n}p_*(\beta_n)$ for all positive levels. There exist a coherent module $A_0$ on $S$ and an isomorphism $b:p^*A_0\simeq F$, together with $A$-linear isomorphisms $e_A:\lim\Gamma(S,G_n)\simeq\Gamma(S,A_0)$ and $e_D:\lim\Gamma(S,D^\wedge_n)\simeq\Gamma(S,p_*F)$ such that $(\lim\Gamma(S,\alpha_n))e_D=e_A\Gamma(S,\eta^a_{A_0}p_*b)$. No exceptional ideal or restriction to its complement is assumed.

proof.text: Apply formalComparison_algebraization_quotient_lift to obtain A0, a formal isomorphism e:G to completion(A0), and the lifted pullback isomorphism b with canonical quotient compatibility.

Apply affine_complete_coherent_sections to A0 and the supplied coherent pushforward of F. Transport the first canonical section-limit isomorphism along e to get eA; invert the second to get eD. Its projection equations give the explicit components of eA inverse and eD inverse.

Precompose the square with eA inverse. Apply proper_complete_quotient_sections_jointly_monic: it suffices to compare every pushed-forward quotient projection. hKappa, the eD equation, limMap_pi, the eA equation, and hAlpha rewrite the left side. Naturality of the supplied adjunction unit with respect to pi followed by e inverse, followed by the quotient-lift equation, gives the right side. This works for any supplied adjunction, including twisted units.

theorem formalComparison_complete_base_algebraization
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    (J : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom))
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [IsProper p]
    (adj : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward p)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) J) (F : CoherentModules Z)
    (β : G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap p) F.obj)
    (h : RingedSpace.IsCoherent (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).toRingedSpace
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F.obj))
    (κ : formalCompletionSystem J ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F.obj) ⟶
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap p) F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward p)
    (α : G ⟶ (completion _ J).obj ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F.obj, h⟩)
    (hKappa : ∀ n : ℕ,
      formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F.obj) ≫
        κ.app (op n) = (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map
          (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap p) (n + 1) F.obj))
    (hAlpha : ∀ n : ℕ, α.hom.app (op n) ≫ κ.app (op n) =
      adj.unit.app (G.obj.obj (op n)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map (β.hom.app (op n))) :
    ∃ (A₀ : CoherentModules (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)))
      (b : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).obj A₀.obj ≅ F.obj),
    ∃ eA : limit (G.obj ⋙ moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)) ≅
        (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).obj A₀.obj,
    ∃ eD : limit (((completion _ J).obj
        ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F.obj, h⟩).obj ⋙
          moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)) ≅
        (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F.obj),
      lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
        (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A))) ≫ eD.hom =
      eA.hom ≫ (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).map
        (adj.unit.app A₀.obj ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map b.hom)
